artifact: Subsystem layout manifest and the migration intent and commit records
authority: 1-architecture/8-architecture-storage-operations.md#migration-and-upgrade (the protocol), owner decisions of 2026-10-07 (labels, types, cardinalities); crates/permguard-host/src/storage/migrate.rs (LayoutManifest, MigrationIntent, MigrationCommit)
encoding: deterministic CBOR (RFC 8949 core deterministic), integers in the signed 64-bit range

fields.name: version
fields.note: the layout version in force, 0 to 65535

fields.name: generation
fields.note: the generation in force; 1 at the first layout, one more per migration

fields.name: directory
fields.note: the generation's directory, `/`-separated, relative to the volume root

fields.name: previous
fields.note: the generation a rollback returns to; present from the commit until finalize

fields.name: to_directory
fields.note: where the new generation is built, relative to the volume root

fields.name: old_digests
fields.note: every file of the old generation by relative path; the rollback point, verified unchanged before the switch

fields.name: backup
fields.note: the external backup the operator declared; required from the production profile upward

fields.name: from_directory
fields.note: the old generation's directory, so recovery and finalize name it without the manifest

fields.name: new_digests
fields.note: every file of the new generation as it was committed; a rollback refuses a generation that no longer matches
